import re

class ConfidenceTier(str, Enum):
    """Ordered confidence tiers for a claim.

    VERIFIED   - backed by at least one artifact evidence reference.

    UNKNOWN    - explicitly acknowledged as not determinable.
    """

    VERIFIED = "verified"
    UNVERIFIED = "unverified"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"

            ConfidenceTier.UNVERIFIED: 1,
